messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable “Goddess and The conquest” game with the user-provided image as the main-menu background.
- Add Sound and Difficulty features to the Options menu.

## Requirements
- Main menu must include Newgame, Loadgame, Option, Created Character (Lock), and Exit.
- Options should include Sound and Difficulty.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.

## Decisions
- Built a celestial-fantasy conquest strategy game around the supplied goddess artwork.
- Difficulty levels are Easy, Normal, and Hard, with different starting resources and enemy behavior.
- Exit displays an in-game farewell screen and attempts to close the browser tab.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created the menu, intro, strategy game, province map, battle/result overlays, save/load, generated audio, and options UI.
- Added Sound controls (master sound toggle, music volume, effects volume) and Easy/Normal/Hard difficulty choices in `index.html`.
- Added difficulty parameters in `js/data.js` and applied them in `js/game.js`.
- Adjusted several province coordinates to avoid map clipping.

### Active
- Finish wiring the new master sound and difficulty controls in `js/main.js`.
- Run syntax and browser checks; confirm menu, options, game, and difficulty selection work.
- Check `git status` and report final state.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Update `js/main.js` options handling to sync and persist `opt-sound`, difficulty selection, and difficulty description; apply selected difficulty when creating a new game.
2. Check for any runtime/syntax errors, then test the Options menu and a new game in the browser.
3. Summarize changes and any assumptions in the completion response.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game screens and the newly edited Options UI.
- `js/main.js`: Application controller; still needs to wire the new options controls.
- `js/data.js`: Province data and Easy/Normal/Hard settings.
- `js/game.js`: Strategy rules and difficulty-dependent gameplay.
- `js/saves.js`: Persistent options and game saves.
- `css/style.css`: Game styling; may need styles for difficulty controls.
- `assets/bg.jpg`: User-provided menu/background image.
- `start.sh`: Starts the local game server.

## Important Context
- The game previously launched at `http://localhost:3002/`; a desktop menu screenshot was saved to `screenshots/menu-desktop.jpg`.
- Initial browser test showed a favicon 404; no other console errors were seen at that point.
- Current `js/main.js` does not yet reference `opt-sound`, `opt-difficulty`, or the selected difficulty for new games.
